claims.claim_text: The indexed Donald W Obenshain is a high-confidence match to the reviewed official Army record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed record and official Army bulk ordinal 8348397 share a nonpublic identifier; the reviewed names agree exactly.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact indexed-name agreement and a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity and an Army entry date, but not a named pre-OSS employer or immediate assignment.
claims.match_notes: The identity decision does not convert coded Army occupation data into employer or occupation evidence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Michael J Obrien is a high-confidence match to the reviewed official Army record, which transposes the spelling to Micheal J Obrien.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed record and official Army bulk ordinal 2624013 share a nonpublic identifier; the reviewed names differ only by the Michael/Micheal spelling.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from a nonshared protected identifier and a close given-name spelling variant; the spelling difference is preserved rather than silently corrected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity and an Army entry date, but not a named pre-OSS employer or immediate assignment.
claims.match_notes: The identity decision accepts the protected-identifier match while retaining Micheal J Obrien as a documented variant.

claims.claim_text: The indexed John M Obereiner is a high-confidence match to the John M Obereiner documented in an OSS Detachment 101 promotion record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary Detachment 101 record lists the same uncommon full name and documents a promotion from private first class to corporal.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact full name and a direct contemporary OSS unit record.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record documents OSS service in March 1945 but gives no pre-OSS employer or preceding assignment.
claims.match_notes: The unit document corroborates identity only; Box 566 is still needed for the pre-OSS chronology.
